subject.title: feat(diagnostics-otel): add vendor-neutral session attribute option for OTel session grouping

question: Should telemetry grouping follow OpenClaw's rotating conversation `sessionId`, or intentionally persist across resets by deriving a pseudonym from the stable routing `sessionKey`?
rationale: That choice determines both user-visible grouping semantics and how long a route-derived identifier remains correlatable outside OpenClaw, so implementation tests cannot establish the intended boundary.

options.title: Follow conversation sessions
options.body: Hash the current opaque `sessionId` so `/new`, `/reset`, daily rollover, and idle expiry begin a new telemetry group.

options.title: Persist across resets
options.body: Retain route-level grouping only after approving a keyed pseudonym design and documenting the cross-reset correlation tradeoff.

options.title: Pause identifier export
options.body: Do not add the option if stable session-derived identifiers are outside the approved telemetry privacy model.

recommendation.title: Follow conversation sessions
recommendation.body: Hash the current opaque `sessionId` so `/new`, `/reset`, daily rollover, and idle expiry begin a new telemetry group.

likelyOwner.reason: The recent merger of adjacent diagnostics-otel configuration and privacy work is the strongest available routing signal for this product boundary.
